scope: Rapid evidence review for a pinned S. cerevisiae v9.1.1 FBA/FVA educational workbench. Model provenance, steady-state constraints, flux nonuniqueness and interpretation limits. No engineered strain design or new empirical validation.
inclusion_criteria: Primary model/method papers supporting the declared computational question; official model/license/format/solver sources.
Foundational papers retained without date limits; newer model paper and current pinned release distinguished.
exclusion_criteria: Organism applications, product optimization, genetic engineering and unrelated biomarker studies.
Claims about dynamic/enzyme-constrained models not transferred to conventional FBA.

searches.note: Executed once during feasibility and repeated to retain structured metadata; duplicate results counted once.

notes: Single-reviewer bounded retrieval, not exhaustive or preregistered; no formal risk-of-bias assessment.
Search result titles were screened; full-text appraisal restricted to relevant method/limitation sections.
Two over-limit full-text requests (max60000) failed argument validation and yielded no text; retried within the allowed limit.
An incorrectly recalled seeded PMID19888272 retrieved an unrelated nutrition paper and was discarded; it is not counted among the20 scoped records.

Direct citation/abstract fetches of five seeded records were repeated by the documentation reviewer; author-list clipping in two records was not completed because full author enumeration was not required.
